Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.


Tasks and responsibilities:

  • Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency;
  • Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders;
  • Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications;
  • Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps;
  • Maintain a centralized log or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization;
  • Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots;
  • Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials;
  • Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;


Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline;
  • +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology;
  • +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams;
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting;
  • Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize);
  • Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights;
  • Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making;
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates;
  • Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred;
  • Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail;
  • AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders;
  • Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes;
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices;
  • Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:

TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;

  • Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus;
  • Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage;
  • Fluent in English;

  • Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração.

  • Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.


Requisitos Técnicos Centrais

  • Expertise em Linux (Obrigatório): Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu . É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.
  • Clustering & HA (Obrigatório - Flexível): Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial, mas outras ferramentas de clustering (como Red Hat HA) são aceitáveis.
  • Proficiência em Nuvem (Obrigatório): Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP . Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud será considerada um diferencial.

  • Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF .


Qualificações e Experiência

  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas.

  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Foco no cliente, pensamento analítico orientado a soluções e capacidade de adquirir novos conhecimentos de forma independente e proativa.

Inglês é Mandatório.

title: Commercial Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Commercial Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position Overview  


Upstart AEC is hiring a Commercial Manager  to lead revenue-focused operations across sales, client communication, and internal delivery coordination. 


This is a full-time, fully remote role with Upstart AEC . The ideal candidate is a senior, sales-minded commercial leader who can operate in a CRO-adjacent capacity, owning revenue execution while ensuring strong alignment across Talent Acquisition, Account Management, and Delivery. 


This person will be responsible for moving qualified opportunities through the sales cycle, keeping deals on track, improving conversion from meetings to revenue, and ensuring internal teams stay aligned around client expectations and business outcomes. 


The ideal candidate brings senior-level sales experience , preferably 10+ years , with experience working with the U.S. market or U.S.-based clients . Experience in nearshore services  is preferred, as is experience helping grow a company from approximately $4M–$5M to $15M–$20M USD  in revenue. 


Key Responsibilities  


  • Own the full sales cycle from qualified opportunity to close, ensuring deals progress consistently and do not stall. 
  • Maintain clear next steps for every active deal and ensure consistent follow-up with prospects and clients. 
  • Partner with outbound efforts to convert meetings into revenue and improve conversion rates. 
  • Drive consistent client communication and follow-up to maintain momentum and build long-term relationships. 
  • Own day-to-day commercial and operational coordination across Talent Acquisition, Account Management, and Delivery. 
  • Hold Talent Acquisition, Account Management, and Delivery teams accountable to timelines, quality standards, and client expectations. 
  • Maintain CRM accuracy, pipeline visibility, and updated deal information. 
  • Monitor active opportunities, identify risks, and drive corrective actions when deals or delivery timelines are at risk. 
  • Provide weekly reporting on pipeline, revenue, and operational performance. 
  • Highlight risks, blockers, and opportunities for improvement across sales and delivery operations. 
  • Help ensure the team remains focused on revenue generation, client satisfaction, and execution quality. 
  • Support revenue growth by improving sales execution, operational follow-through, and conversion from meetings to closed business. 


Required Skills  


  • 10+ years of senior sales or commercial leadership experience . 
  • Experience working with the U.S. market or U.S.-based clients . 
  • Strong sales and revenue mindset, with the ability to own opportunities from qualified lead to close. 
  • Experience managing sales pipelines, client follow-up, and deal progression. 
  • Strong CRM discipline, including accurate pipeline tracking and clear next-step management. 
  • Ability to coordinate across multiple internal teams and hold stakeholders accountable. 
  • Strong communication skills with both clients and internal team members. 
  • Ability to identify stalled deals, operational gaps, or risks and take action to move things forward. 
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment where priorities may shift. 
  • Comfortable reporting on pipeline, revenue, operational performance, and key risks. 
  • Strong sense of ownership, urgency, and accountability. 
  • Ability to operate at both a strategic and hands-on level, balancing revenue leadership with day-to-day execution. 


Nice-to-Have Skills  


  • Experience in a revenue leadership, sales operations, commercial operations, or CRO-adjacent role. 
  • Experience in nearshore services. 
  • Experience helping grow a company from approximately $4M–$5M to $15M–$20M USD  in revenue. 
  • Experience working with Talent Acquisition, Account Management, or Delivery teams. 
  • Experience improving meeting-to-revenue conversion rates. 
  • Experience managing client relationships in a service-based business environment. 
  • Experience selling services, recruiting solutions, staffing, consulting, or other people-based business solutions. 


Compensation Range


  • Base compensation: $60,000–$100,000 USD
  • Commission: Yes
  • On-target earnings: $120,000–$200,000 USD

title: CONSULTORA COMERCIAL | CLÍNICA DE HARMONIZAÇÃO FACIAL
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para CONSULTORA COMERCIAL | CLÍNICA DE HARMONIZAÇÃO FACIAL em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

WANTED: Consultora comercial que sabe que lead quente não espera. E que não vai deixar nenhum escapar.


Cara leitora,

Se você está rolando o LinkedIn há dias vendo as mesmas vagas de sempre...

\"Buscamos profissional proativo com boa comunicação\" \"Requisitos: Excel avançado e experiência na área\" \"Oferecemos: salário compatível com o mercado\"

..e sente que nenhuma dessas vagas te dá vontade de levantar da cadeira e se candidatar...


Para.


Essa aqui é diferente.


Sabe aquela sensação de fazer uma venda e pensar \"eu SABIA que ia fechar\"?


É isso que você vai sentir aqui. Todo dia.


Porque os leads já chegam interessados. Eles viram os resultados no Instagram. Já querem fazer o procedimento. Já estão imaginando como vão ficar. Já pesquisaram sobre harmonização.


O trabalho pesado de gerar desejo? O Instagram já fez.


Só falta uma coisa: alguém que conduza a conversa até o agendamento.


Esse alguém é você.


Você não vai precisar convencer ninguém de que harmonização funciona - os antes e depois fazem isso. Você não vai precisar criar desejo do zero - as fotos e vídeos criam. Você não vai precisar explicar por que vale a pena - as pacientes satisfeitas mostram.


O que você vai precisar fazer é simples e poderoso: responder rápido, entender o momento da cliente, tirar as dúvidas certas, e não deixar ela escapar enquanto \"pensa\".


A clínica entrega o resultado. O Instagram entrega o lead. Você entrega a consulta paga.


É uma máquina. E você é a peça que faz ela funcionar.


Sem você, lead vira só número no direct. Com você, lead vira paciente na agenda, faturamento no caixa, transformação na vida de uma mulher.


SOBRE A CLÍNICA


Somos uma clínica de harmonização facial que transforma a autoestima de mulheres todos os dias.

Nosso Instagram gera interesse. Nossos procedimentos geram resultado. Nossas pacientes geram indicações.

A demanda existe. O desejo existe. A confiança existe.

O que falta é você conectando tudo isso em consultas pagas.


VOCÊ É...


O tipo de pessoa que vê uma notificação no direct e já sente a adrenalina de uma possível conversão.

Que entende que velocidade é conversão - e age de acordo.

Que não manda preço e espera. Manda preço e já prepara o próximo passo.

Que trata \"vou pensar\" como o início da venda, não como o fim.

Que sente satisfação real quando transforma uma conversa difícil em agendamento confirmado.

É quase como se uma closer, uma estrategista e uma organizadora obsessiva tivessem uma filha.

Você tem fome de resultado. E a estrutura pra sustentar isso.


SUA MISSÃO


Transformar seguidores em leads. Transformar leads em consultas pagas. Transformar consultas em pacientes recorrentes.

Seu trabalho é não deixar ninguém escapar do funil.

..mas antes que você fique toda empolgada, vou te interromper aqui...

Porque essa função não é fácil. Ok?


Exige velocidade. Exige organização. Exige resiliência. E exige uma capacidade rara de manter o ritmo intenso dia após dia.

A carga é pesada. O ritmo é acelerado. E a gente só quer quem aguenta o tranco.


NA PRÁTICA, VOCÊ VAI:


● Monitorar o Instagram como um radar: Comentários, DMs, reações, menções. Onde tem interação, tem oportunidade. Você não espera aparecer - você vai buscar.

● Abordar rápido e trazer pro WhatsApp: A rede social é vitrine. O WhatsApp é onde você controla a conversa. Você faz essa ponte em minutos, não em horas.

● Qualificar a necessidade: Entender o que ela quer, qual o momento dela, quais as dúvidas reais. Não é só \"passar informação\" - é descobrir como ajudar ela a decidir.

● Conduzir com estratégia até a consulta PAGA: Você não agenda. Você FECHA. O ciclo só termina quando tem pagamento.

● Confirmar as consultas agendadas: Ligação, mensagem, lembrete. O que for preciso pra garantir que ela apareça. No-show é zero no caixa.

● Follow-up como rotina sagrada:

○ Lead que perguntou e sumiu? Volta nele.

○ Lead que disse \"tá caro\"? Entende a objeção real.

○ Lead que disse \"vou pensar\"? Mantém o relacionamento até ela decidir.

○ Paciente que cancelou? Reagenda.

○ Paciente que fez há 6 meses? Hora da manutenção.

● Trabalhar a base de pacientes existentes: Quem já fez uma vez, volta. Quem gostou, indica. Sua função é ativar isso. Todo dia.

● Manter o CRM organizado em tempo real: Status atualizado, próximo passo definido, histórico completo. Você precisa saber exatamente onde cada lead está no funil.


SEUS INDICADORES DE SUCESSO


O QUE MUDA NO SEU DIA A DIA


Urgência é regra. Seguidor que comentou AGORA precisa ser atendido AGORA. Não daqui a

pouco. Não quando der. AGORA. Lead quente esfria em minutos. A concorrente responde em

segundos. Velocidade é conversão.


O objetivo é consulta PAGA. Vamos deixar claro: agendar não é o objetivo. Faturar é.

Consulta marcada que não acontece é zero no caixa. Consulta marcada que não paga é

prejuízo de tempo. O ciclo só fecha quando a consulta é paga e realizada.


Base de pacientes é ouro. Sabe aquela planilha de pacientes antigos que ninguém mexe?

Isso é dinheiro parado. Cada nome ali é uma mulher que já confiou na clínica, já viu resultado,

já tem relacionamento. Reativar a base é mais fácil que conquistar lead novo. E você vai fazer

isso todo dia.


Follow-up é onde o dinheiro está. A maioria das secretárias manda preço e espera. Você

não. Você entende que \"vou pensar\" não é não - é \"me convença\". Você sabe que quem sumiu

depois do orçamento só precisa do lembrete certo no momento certo. Seu follow-up é o que

separa agenda vazia de agenda lotada.


NÃO É PRA VOCÊ SE:


● Acha follow-up \"chato\" ou \"insistente demais\"

● Manda preço e espera a cliente decidir sozinha

● Tem vergonha de puxar a conversa pra venda

● Acha que responder \"quando der\" é aceitável

● Desaparece no horário de almoço quando os leads estão pipocando

● Vê atendimento como tarefa, não como oportunidade de fechar

● Precisa que alguém fique cobrando pra você fazer follow-up


É PRA VOCÊ SE:


● Entende que cada lead ignorado é dinheiro perdido

● Sente satisfação real quando converte uma conversa difícil

● Faz follow-up naturalmente - não precisa de lembrete

● Age como se cada lead fosse dinheiro do seu bolso

● Tem organização: não deixa nada cair no esquecimento

● Gosta de ritmo intenso e resultado visível

● Entende que vender bem é atender bem


A CANDIDATA DOS SONHOS TEM:


Velocidade: Você não deixa lead esfriar. Chegou, você responde. Ponto.

Fome de resultado: Você quer converter. Quer bater meta. Quer ver o número subir.

Resiliência: \"Vou pensar\" não te desanima. Te dá mais vontade de fazer o follow-up certo.

Organização obsessiva: CRM atualizado, follow-ups no dia certo, zero lead esquecido. Sem precisar de cobrança.

Ownership: Você trata cada lead como se fosse dinheiro do seu bolso. Porque, com comissão, é.

Ritmo: Você aguenta carga intensa. E gosta disso.


A MELHOR PARTE


● Remuneração competitiva: Fixo + comissão por resultado. Quanto mais você converte, mais você ganha.

● Crescimento direto: Seu salário cresce junto com sua performance. Sem teto.

● Ambiente meritocrático: Aqui vale quem gera número, não aparência de trabalho.

● Autonomia total: Liberdade pra conduzir suas conversas e criar suas estratégias. 

● Feedback claro: Você sabe exatamente se está performando ou não. Sem subjetividade.

● Treinamento: Você não vai ser jogada no fogo. Vai aprender o método que funciona.

● Impacto real: Cada consulta que você agenda muda a autoestima de uma mulher.


Se você leu até aqui e pensou \"parece muito trabalho\"... não é pra você. E tá tudo bem.

Se pensou \"finalmente uma vaga que paga por resultado de verdade\"... você é exatamente quem procuramos.

Nos movemos em ritmo acelerado. Apenas candidatas que se destacarem serão contatadas.

Se você não receber contato em 5 dias úteis, infelizmente não foi dessa vez.

Palavras-chave: Secretária comercial, vaga secretária, vaga comercial, atendimento WhatsApp, atendimento Instagram, agendamento de consultas, clínica de estética, harmonização facial, vaga presencial, vaga CLT, vaga PJ, vendas, conversão de leads, follow-up, CRM, recepcionista comercial, atendente comercial, pré-vendas, SDR, closer, inside sales, vaga estética, clínica estética, consultora comercial, assistente comercial, captação de clientes, relacionamento com cliente.

title: Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover)

Duration: 6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units.

This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions.

The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation.


Key Responsibilities

  • Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact
  • Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders.
  • Retention Analysis & Insight
  • Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk.
  • Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement
  • Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month.
  • Salesforce Data Quality & Governance
  • Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn.
  • Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation
  • Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.



Required Qualifications & Experience

Technical & Operational Expertise

  • Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role.
  • Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting.
  • High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs.
  • Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous.

Revenue & Churn Acumen

  • Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business.
  • Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics.
  • Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends.
  • Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations.
  • Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.

Why This Role Matters

Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue.

As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

Contract Duration: 6 months (with potential for extension/long-term partnership)

Role Overview

We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only: Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery.

As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R&D, Product, and Growth) across the U.S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground.

  • High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery: Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via LinkedIn, regional job boards, GitHub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing.
  • HQ & Candidate Facilitation: Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact.
  • Data & Pipeline Transparency: Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast.


The DNA We Are Looking For-

The Baseline (Hard Skills):

  • Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese): Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages. You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese.
  • Proven Recruitment Engine: 2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus.
  • Geographic Flexibility: Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U.S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset.


Core Traits (Soft Skills):

  • The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine: You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions.
  • Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails: You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack.


What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face

What You Will Get:

  • Uncapped Earning Potential: On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn.
  • The Global Flex-Work Playbook: Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network.
  • A Trusted Extension of the Crew: No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind.


The Challenges You Will Face:

  • 100% Remote Coordination: Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule.
  • Embracing Ambiguity: Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts.


If you are a bilingual recruitment hustler who is ready to deliver global talent and write your own paycheck via performance bonuses, let’s talk. Apply now and let’s make a global impact together!

title: Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover)

Duration: 6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units.

This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions.

The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation.


Key Responsibilities

  • Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact
  • Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders.
  • Retention Analysis & Insight
  • Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk.
  • Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement
  • Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month.
  • Salesforce Data Quality & Governance
  • Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn.
  • Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation
  • Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.



Required Qualifications & Experience

Technical & Operational Expertise

  • Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role.
  • Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting.
  • High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs.
  • Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous.

Revenue & Churn Acumen

  • Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business.
  • Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics.
  • Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends.
  • Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations.
  • Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.

Why This Role Matters

Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue.

As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position Summary


The Data Analyst supports the company’s data and analytics initiatives by designing, developing, and maintaining dashboards, reports, and data solutions that provide actionable insights to leadership and stakeholders. This role is responsible for transforming complex data into clear, meaningful visualizations and analysis to support data-driven decision-making. The Data Analyst partners with technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure data accuracy, accessibility, and usability. This position contributes to advanced analytics, forecasting, and continuous improvement of reporting capabilities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain dashboards and reports using Power BI.
  • Build and maintain data models, custom measures, and calculations using DAX and Power Query.
  • Analyze and validate data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy, consistency, and usability.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and reporting.
  • Present insights, trends, and findings clearly to executive leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Develop predictive models and apply forecasting and statistical techniques to support business planning.
  • Leverage Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric to support advanced analytics solutions.
  • Partner with stakeholders to define reporting requirements and deliver analytics solutions aligned with business needs.
  • Educate and support teams on data concepts, reporting tools, and analytics best practices.
  • Operate effectively in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment while managing multiple priorities.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities assigned due to business needs.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong proficiency in Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and data modeling.
  • Strong SQL skills with the ability to extract, transform, and analyze data efficiently.
  • Experience with Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric.
  • Ability to present complex data clearly and effectively to non-technical audiences.
  • Knowledge of predictive analytics, forecasting, machine learning, and statistical analysis techniques.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Passion for data visualization, continuous learning, and process improvement.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational, time-management, and prioritization skills.

Education, Training, and Experience

  • High school diploma required; college degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field preferred.
  • 3+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related role required.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Power BI required.
  • Demonstrated experience developing dashboards, reports, and data models required.
  • Experience working with cloud-based data platforms and analytics tools preferred.
  • Experience presenting data insights to leadership and non-technical audiences preferred.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

FirstIgnite develops AI-powered tools designed to support universities in key areas such as Tech Transfer, Corporate Relations, Advancement, Career Development, and Research Development. These tools empower universities to expand their initiatives and streamline operations effectively. FirstIgnite is dedicated to helping academic institutions grow and thrive through innovative technological solutions, making a meaningful impact in the education sector.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Data Engineer. The Data Engineer, will lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data systems focused on acquiring, structuring, and integrating diverse datasets from external and internal sources. This role will be responsible for building reliable data acquisition pipelines, including crawling, scraping, API ingestion, data mining, enrichment, and ETL workflows that turn messy public or semi-public sources into accurate, usable data for FirstIgnite’s platform.


Qualifications

  • Lead the architecture, development, and optimization of scalable data pipelines for patents, grants, clinical trials, publications, labs, and firmographic sources.
  • Build and maintain ETL workflows on AWS using Glue (PySpark), Lambda, S3, and RDS PostgreSQL.
  • Explore and implement complementary data storage solutions as needed.
  • Apply machine learning and LLM-based techniques to extract, structure, and enrich data at scale.
  • Ensure data integrity, security, accuracy, and governance across all systems.
  • Implement tools for data exploration, visualization, and actionable insights.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to drive AI-driven innovation.
  • Evaluate emerging AI/ML techniques and tools to enhance platform capabilities.
  • Maintain version control, CI/CD pipelines, and reproducible workflows for the data engineering team.


Requirements

  • Strong programming expertise in Python, with experience building production data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS data services (Glue/PySpark, Lambda, S3, RDS PostgreSQL, SSM) or equivalent cloud data stacks.
  • Strong experience with external data acquisition, including building and maintaining crawlers, scrapers, API integrations, and data mining workflows that turn messy public or semi-public sources into reliable, structured datasets. This includes handling rate limits, source changes, deduplication, validation, enrichment, and pipeline monitoring.
  • Familiarity with RESTful and GraphQL APIs, ETL processes, and data integration strategies.
  • Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI-enhanced data applications.
  • Strong analytical skills, including evaluating trade-offs of data ingestion and storage methods.
  • Leadership experience managing data engineering or AI teams in SaaS or tech environments.
  • Solid knowledge of version control (Git) and CI/CD practices.
  • Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills in cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and drive projects from conception to deployment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with web scraping at scale (Firecrawl or similar).
  • LLM-based data extraction and prompt engineering for structured output.
  • Data quality instrumentation and observability for pipelines.


As part of your LinkedIn application submission, please use Loom to record a video and email it to us within the next 48 hours. The recording should include both your camera (showing yourself) and your screen as you walk us through a project or piece of code you’re proud of.


Please email the video to with the title of the position you are applying for in the subject line. We look forward to your submission!

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para \"Engenheiro de dados #997215\" em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Conhecimento técnico esperado:

  • Experiência comprovada em ambientes de nuvem - Azure, AWS ou GCP;
  • Domínio e aplicação de Arquiteturas Lakehouse;
  • Conhecimento de ambientes de Data Lakes;
  • Conhecimento em Arquitetura de Event-Driven (EDA)
  • Conhecimento em Mensageria (Kafka, Eventhubs, SQS, ServiceBus ou PubSub)
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de integração de dados (StreamSets ou Azure Data Factory);
  • Conhecimento de tecnologias de processamento de dados (ex.: Spark, Scala, Databricks);
  • Conhecimento sobre bases de dados relacionais (ex.: PostgreSQL) e não-relacionais (ex.: MongoDB);
  • Capacidade de analisar e modelar bases de dados;
  • Conhecer fluxos e ferramentas de CI/CD;
  • Domínio da metodologia Ágil;
  • Conhecimento em padrões de MicroServies.


No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

Trabalhar junto às áreas de segurança, dados, infraestrutura e governança corporativa.

Boa comunicação com stakeholders técnicos e executivos.

Inglês técnico e capacidade de interação com fornecedores e tecnologias globais.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Specialist

Role Overview

We are seeking a proactive and adaptable Talent Acquisition Specialist with experience recruiting across multiple industries and mid-level roles , including global and remote hiring.

This role is critical to building a high-quality, scalable team. You will partner closely with hiring managers across departments to identify talent needs, run efficient hiring processes, and bring in candidates who align with both skill requirements and company culture.


Key Responsibilities


Full-Cycle Recruiting

  • Own end-to-end recruitment for mid-level roles across functions (Marketing, Operations, Customer Support, etc.)
  • Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements and candidate profiles
  • Manage job postings across platforms and optimize for visibility and quality
  • Screen candidates, conduct initial interviews, and coordinate hiring processes
  • Drive structured and efficient interview workflows


Global & Remote Hiring

  • Source and recruit candidates across different regions and time zones
  • Manage remote hiring processes and candidate experience end-to-end
  • Navigate international talent pools and adapt sourcing strategies accordingly
  • Ensure smooth coordination across distributed teams


Sourcing & Pipeline Building

  • Proactively source candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, and other channels
  • Build and maintain strong candidate pipelines for recurring roles
  • Identify and engage passive candidates
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies based on role and market conditions


Process & Operations

  • Track candidate progress and maintain organized pipelines
  • Improve recruiting workflows, documentation, and systems
  • Ensure a high-quality candidate experience throughout the process
  • Support reporting on hiring metrics and pipeline health


Required Skills & Experience

  • 4–5+ years of experience in recruiting or talent acquisition
  • Experience hiring across multiple industries or functions
  • Proven experience recruiting mid-level roles end-to-end
  • Experience with remote and global hiring
  • Strong sourcing skills (LinkedIn, outbound, etc.)
  • Excellent organizational and pipeline management skills
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities


What Makes You Exceptional

  • You can quickly understand different roles across functions and industries
  • You are resourceful and know how to find talent in competitive markets
  • You bring structure and clarity to hiring processes
  • You are highly responsive and keep both candidates and hiring managers aligned
  • You balance speed with quality in hiring decisions
  • You are comfortable operating in a fast-moving, evolving environment


Why This Role Matters

As Carepod grows, hiring the right people efficiently becomes a key driver of success.

  • This role ensures we build strong teams across functions and geographies by bringing in high-quality talent and maintaining a structured, scalable hiring process. Your work will directly impact team performance, company culture, and our ability to grow effectively.


Requirements added by the job poster

• 3+ years of Staffing and Recruiting experience

• 3+ years of work experience with 360 Recruitment

title: Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover)

Duration: 6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units.

This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions.

The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation.


Key Responsibilities

  • Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact
  • Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders.
  • Retention Analysis & Insight
  • Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk.
  • Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement
  • Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month.
  • Salesforce Data Quality & Governance
  • Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn.
  • Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation
  • Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.



Required Qualifications & Experience

Technical & Operational Expertise

  • Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role.
  • Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting.
  • High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs.
  • Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous.

Revenue & Churn Acumen

  • Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business.
  • Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics.
  • Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends.
  • Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations.
  • Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.

Why This Role Matters

Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue.

As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

title: Client Services Assistant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Client Services Assistant em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Client Services Assistant

Remote, Latin America


Velocity Work helps law firm owners build firms that are profitable, organized, accountable, and not dependent on the owner holding everything together.


We’re hiring a Client Services Assistant to become a true backbone for our team.


This is not a “wait for instructions” role. It’s for someone who sees loose ends, tracks the moving pieces, asks smart questions, and makes the system better without needing someone to hover.


You’ll support current clients, client data, retreat prep, onboarding, internal systems, pipeline tracking, and podcast scheduling. The work is detailed, important, and very real.


If you like being the person who knows where things stand, what’s missing, and what needs to happen next, this may be a great fit.


What You’ll Own -----------


Client Services Operations


This is the center of the role.


You’ll help keep current client work moving cleanly: data workflows, dashboards, retreat materials, onboarding, HubSpot notes, scheduling details, internal reports, recordings, client folders, and recurring team systems.


You’ll also help catch what’s slipping before it becomes a problem: missing data, unclear ownership, stalled tasks, unlogged client context, messy files, late follow-ups, or anything that makes Client Services feel less prepared.


The goal is simple: current clients feel cared for, Client Services feels supported, and the team trusts that the operational details are handled.


Pipeline + Relationship Tracking


You’ll help us track important non-client relationships: incoming leads, meetings, deals, contracts, key dates, next steps, and handoffs.


You won’t be the salesperson or the primary external email owner. You’ll keep the system accurate so the right person can follow through well and Client Services can provide a high-touch experience before someone becomes a client.


Podcast Scheduling + Production Coordination


You’ll help keep our podcast schedule realistic and ahead of the calendar.


That means protecting planning time, suggesting recording days that match the production schedule, tracking key dates, and flagging when we need to record multiple episodes ahead because the business calendar is getting full.


You won’t own content, writing, editing, or creative direction. This is schedule, process, and timeline management.


This Role Is a Fit If You:


• Notice gaps and communicate them early

• Take ownership without needing to be chased

• Track details carefully and follow through completely

• Ask smart questions, then remember the answer

• Can support a busy team without adding noise

• Stay calm when priorities shift

• Take pride in being reliable, thorough, and useful


This Role Is Not a Fit If You:


• Need detailed instructions for every task

• Wait to be told what to do next

• See problems but don’t speak up

• Think “done” means “mostly handled”

• Struggle when a process is not perfectly documented


Requirements


• Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

• Clear written and verbal English

• High ownership and follow-through

• Strong attention to detail

• Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities

• Experience with calendars, spreadsheets, CRMs, project management tools, and modern SaaS systems

• Fast, stable internet connection

• Professional presence on video


Tools may include ClickUp, HubSpot, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Loom, Fireflies, reporting dashboards, spreadsheets, and podcast scheduling tools.


Work Setup


Remote, Latin America preferred

Contractor, 40 hours/week with meaningful overlap with U.S. business hours

Compensation: $1000/mo USD (you will invoce your hours)


How to Apply


We care about experience, but we care more about ownership, judgment, communication, and follow-through.


If shortlisted, we will ask that you submit:


• Your resume

• A short video introducing yourself and telling us why this role speaks to you

• Anything else that helps us understand how you think and work


We will follow up with a final list of prospects and request a Sample Project submission that will demonstrate aspects of the work you'll be doing, and we will compensate you for the time that takes.


We’re looking for someone who wants to become a real operational partner to the team, not just complete assigned tasks.


If you’re the kind of person who sees the gap, owns the follow-through, and makes the whole team feel more organized, we want to meet you.

title: Commercial Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Commercial Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position Overview  


Upstart AEC is hiring a Commercial Manager  to lead revenue-focused operations across sales, client communication, and internal delivery coordination. 


This is a full-time, fully remote role with Upstart AEC . The ideal candidate is a senior, sales-minded commercial leader who can operate in a CRO-adjacent capacity, owning revenue execution while ensuring strong alignment across Talent Acquisition, Account Management, and Delivery. 


This person will be responsible for moving qualified opportunities through the sales cycle, keeping deals on track, improving conversion from meetings to revenue, and ensuring internal teams stay aligned around client expectations and business outcomes. 


The ideal candidate brings senior-level sales experience , preferably 10+ years , with experience working with the U.S. market or U.S.-based clients . Experience in nearshore services  is preferred, as is experience helping grow a company from approximately $4M–$5M to $15M–$20M USD  in revenue. 


Key Responsibilities  


  • Own the full sales cycle from qualified opportunity to close, ensuring deals progress consistently and do not stall. 
  • Maintain clear next steps for every active deal and ensure consistent follow-up with prospects and clients. 
  • Partner with outbound efforts to convert meetings into revenue and improve conversion rates. 
  • Drive consistent client communication and follow-up to maintain momentum and build long-term relationships. 
  • Own day-to-day commercial and operational coordination across Talent Acquisition, Account Management, and Delivery. 
  • Hold Talent Acquisition, Account Management, and Delivery teams accountable to timelines, quality standards, and client expectations. 
  • Maintain CRM accuracy, pipeline visibility, and updated deal information. 
  • Monitor active opportunities, identify risks, and drive corrective actions when deals or delivery timelines are at risk. 
  • Provide weekly reporting on pipeline, revenue, and operational performance. 
  • Highlight risks, blockers, and opportunities for improvement across sales and delivery operations. 
  • Help ensure the team remains focused on revenue generation, client satisfaction, and execution quality. 
  • Support revenue growth by improving sales execution, operational follow-through, and conversion from meetings to closed business. 


Required Skills  


  • 10+ years of senior sales or commercial leadership experience . 
  • Experience working with the U.S. market or U.S.-based clients . 
  • Strong sales and revenue mindset, with the ability to own opportunities from qualified lead to close. 
  • Experience managing sales pipelines, client follow-up, and deal progression. 
  • Strong CRM discipline, including accurate pipeline tracking and clear next-step management. 
  • Ability to coordinate across multiple internal teams and hold stakeholders accountable. 
  • Strong communication skills with both clients and internal team members. 
  • Ability to identify stalled deals, operational gaps, or risks and take action to move things forward. 
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment where priorities may shift. 
  • Comfortable reporting on pipeline, revenue, operational performance, and key risks. 
  • Strong sense of ownership, urgency, and accountability. 
  • Ability to operate at both a strategic and hands-on level, balancing revenue leadership with day-to-day execution. 


Nice-to-Have Skills  


  • Experience in a revenue leadership, sales operations, commercial operations, or CRO-adjacent role. 
  • Experience in nearshore services. 
  • Experience helping grow a company from approximately $4M–$5M to $15M–$20M USD  in revenue. 
  • Experience working with Talent Acquisition, Account Management, or Delivery teams. 
  • Experience improving meeting-to-revenue conversion rates. 
  • Experience managing client relationships in a service-based business environment. 
  • Experience selling services, recruiting solutions, staffing, consulting, or other people-based business solutions. 


Compensation Range


  • Base compensation: $60,000–$100,000 USD
  • Commission: Yes
  • On-target earnings: $120,000–$200,000 USD

title: Senior Auditor – Licensing & Compliance (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Auditor – Licensing & Compliance (LATAM) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us  


At Simplify CCS, we specialize in innovative contract compliance audits that deliver real value to our clients. Our work supports companies in safeguarding their strategic relationships with vendors, customers, and partners. Since 2014, we've combined expertise in audits, data analytics, and risk management to provide world-class Strategic Contract Risk Management Solutions. 


Headquartered in USA, with a presence in LATAM and EMEA, Simplify serves a global clientele, growing exponentially for over 10 years because our clients understand and appreciate our approach to compliance testing through data analysis, delivered by our team of well trained and motivated subject matter experts. We are a growing international company, and we’re excited to expand our presence in Latin America—starting with you. 


Our purpose: Detect the Unseen. Defend Fairness. Deliver Trust. 


Your Role & Responsibilities 


You’ll play a key role in owning and executing audit engagements, ensuring compliance with internal controls and external standards, and contributing directly to client-facing work. This is a senior individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities although with responsibility for mentoring, guiding, and reviewing the work of junior auditors 


We are hiring for one experienced audit professional with approximately 5–6+ years of relevant audit experience who is comfortable working independently in a small, fast-moving environment. 


Your main areas of impact: 


  • Lead Licensing Audit Engagements: Take ownership of reviewing and analyzing licensing agreements, contracts, and large datasets to assess compliance and identify potential financial recovery opportunities. 
  • Advanced Data Analysis & Testing: Design and execute audit test plans, independently analyze client data, identify anomalies, and quantify discrepancies with minimal oversight. 
  • Client-Facing Reporting & Insights: Draft clear, well-structured audit reports that communicate key findings, root causes, and practical recommendations to improve client governance and contract compliance. 
  • Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders and global team members, proactively sharing progress, risks, and insights to ensure audits are delivered on time and to a high standard. 
  • Process Improvement & Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to improving audit methodologies, templates, and internal processes. Support internal initiatives such as training, documentation, and continuous improvement efforts. 


✅ What You Bring 


  • You hold a degree in Accounting, or Finance and are eager to apply your knowledge in real-world audit scenarios; professional certifications (CPA, CIA, CISA, ACCA) are a plus 
  • 5–6+ years of experience in Contract Compliance auditing and/or Forensic Accounting within professional services; experience in the licensing industry is plus.
  • Expert in Excel and familiar with data tools such as Power BI and similar. 
  • English Level Advanced (C1/C2 Required). 
  • Detail-oriented and analytical, skilled to identify risks, patterns and inconsistencies within contracts and large datasets. 
  • Proactive Team player, demonstrating flexibility, resilience, and the ability to adapt to shifting priorities and working hours. 
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex audit findings and present insights to stakeholders with confidence and impact. 
  • Ability to mentor and develop junior team members, providing guidance, feedback, and ongoing support. 


What We Offer (LATAM - Remote) 


  • Fully Remote Setup 
  • Flexible Hours: Adapt your work schedule to fit your rhythm—coordinate global projects without overtime overload (mostly following EST time zone).  
  • Paid learning: Access to language courses, online platforms, professional certifications all tailored to your personal and career goals. 
  • Competitive USD compensation 
  • Team Culture: Join a diverse, supportive team that values open communication, transparency, and collaboration. 
  • Global Exposure: Gain hands-on experience with international clients across LATAM, EMEA, and North America. 
  • Generous Paid Time Off: Enjoy 26 days of paid vacation each year to rest, recharge, and come back inspired. 
  • Fully Equipped for Success: We’ll provide all the equipment you need — from laptops to accessories — so you can do your best work from anywhere. 
  • Comprehensive Healthcare: Your well-being matters. We offer healthcare coverage to ensure you’re supported both personally and professionally. 


We value collaboration, integrity, accountability, and a strong client-first mindset, while always finding ways to get great work done. 


⏰ Recruitment Process 


  • Application: Submit your application via LinkedIn. 
  • Initial Screening: Our team will review your profile to assess fit and experience. 
  • Phone Interview: A short introductory call to understand your motivation and answer initial questions. 
  • Technical Assessment: You'll complete a practical task or case study. 
  • Final Interview: Meet with senior team members for a deeper conversation about the role and your potential fit. 
  • Offer: If it's a match, you'll receive a formal offer to join our team!

  • Client-Facing Reporting & Insights: Draft clear, well-structured audit reports that communicate key findings, root causes, and practical recommendations to improve client governance and contract compliance. 
  • Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders and global team members, proactively sharing progress, risks, and insights to ensure audits are delivered on time and to a high standard. 
  • Process Improvement & Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to improving audit methodologies, templates, and internal processes. Support internal initiatives such as training, documentation, and continuous improvement efforts. 


✅ What You Bring 


  • You hold a degree in Accounting, or Finance and are eager to apply your knowledge in real-world audit scenarios; professional certifications (CPA, CIA, CISA, ACCA) are a plus 
  • 5–6+ years of experience in Contract Compliance auditing and/or Forensic Accounting within professional services; experience in the licensing industry is plus.
  • Expert in Excel and familiar with data tools such as Power BI and similar. 
  • English Level Advanced (C1/C2 Required). 
  • Detail-oriented and analytical, skilled to identify risks, patterns and inconsistencies within contracts and large datasets. 
  • Proactive Team player, demonstrating flexibility, resilience, and the ability to adapt to shifting priorities and working hours. 
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex audit findings and present insights to stakeholders with confidence and impact. 
  • Ability to mentor and develop junior team members, providing guidance, feedback, and ongoing support. 


What We Offer (LATAM - Remote) 


  • Fully Remote Setup 
  • Flexible Hours: Adapt your work schedule to fit your rhythm—coordinate global projects without overtime overload (mostly following EST time zone).  
  • Paid learning: Access to language courses, online platforms, professional certifications all tailored to your personal and career goals. 
  • Competitive USD compensation 
  • Team Culture: Join a diverse, supportive team that values open communication, transparency, and collaboration. 
  • Global Exposure: Gain hands-on experience with international clients across LATAM, EMEA, and North America. 
  • Generous Paid Time Off: Enjoy 26 days of paid vacation each year to rest, recharge, and come back inspired. 
  • Fully Equipped for Success: We’ll provide all the equipment you need — from laptops to accessories — so you can do your best work from anywhere. 
  • Comprehensive Healthcare: Your well-being matters. We offer healthcare coverage to ensure you’re supported both personally and professionally. 


We value collaboration, integrity, accountability, and a strong client-first mindset, while always finding ways to get great work done. 


⏰ Recruitment Process 


  • Application: Submit your application via LinkedIn. 
  • Initial Screening: Our team will review your profile to assess fit and experience. 
  • Phone Interview: A short introductory call to understand your motivation and answer initial questions. 
  • Technical Assessment: You'll complete a practical task or case study. 
  • Final Interview: Meet with senior team members for a deeper conversation about the role and your potential fit. 
  • Offer: If it's a match, you'll receive a formal offer to join our team!

Porque os leads já chegam interessados. Eles viram os resultados no Instagram. Já querem fazer o procedimento. Já estão imaginando como vão ficar. Já pesquisaram sobre harmonização.


O trabalho pesado de gerar desejo? O Instagram já fez.


Só falta uma coisa: alguém que conduza a conversa até o agendamento.


Esse alguém é você.


Você não vai precisar convencer ninguém de que harmonização funciona - os antes e depois fazem isso. Você não vai precisar criar desejo do zero - as fotos e vídeos criam. Você não vai precisar explicar por que vale a pena - as pacientes satisfeitas mostram.


O que você vai precisar fazer é simples e poderoso: responder rápido, entender o momento da cliente, tirar as dúvidas certas, e não deixar ela escapar enquanto \"pensa\".


A clínica entrega o resultado. O Instagram entrega o lead. Você entrega a consulta paga.


É uma máquina. E você é a peça que faz ela funcionar.


Sem você, lead vira só número no direct. Com você, lead vira paciente na agenda, faturamento no caixa, transformação na vida de uma mulher.


SOBRE A CLÍNICA


Somos uma clínica de harmonização facial que transforma a autoestima de mulheres todos os dias.

Nosso Instagram gera interesse. Nossos procedimentos geram resultado. Nossas pacientes geram indicações.

A demanda existe. O desejo existe. A confiança existe.

O que falta é você conectando tudo isso em consultas pagas.


VOCÊ É...


O tipo de pessoa que vê uma notificação no direct e já sente a adrenalina de uma possível conversão.

Que entende que velocidade é conversão - e age de acordo.

Que não manda preço e espera. Manda preço e já prepara o próximo passo.

Que trata \"vou pensar\" como o início da venda, não como o fim.

Que sente satisfação real quando transforma uma conversa difícil em agendamento confirmado.

É quase como se uma closer, uma estrategista e uma organizadora obsessiva tivessem uma filha.

Você tem fome de resultado. E a estrutura pra sustentar isso.


SUA MISSÃO


Transformar seguidores em leads. Transformar leads em consultas pagas. Transformar consultas em pacientes recorrentes.

Seu trabalho é não deixar ninguém escapar do funil.

..mas antes que você fique toda empolgada, vou te interromper aqui...

Porque essa função não é fácil. Ok?


Exige velocidade. Exige organização. Exige resiliência. E exige uma capacidade rara de manter o ritmo intenso dia após dia.

A carga é pesada. O ritmo é acelerado. E a gente só quer quem aguenta o tranco.


NA PRÁTICA, VOCÊ VAI:


● Monitorar o Instagram como um radar: Comentários, DMs, reações, menções. Onde tem interação, tem oportunidade. Você não espera aparecer - você vai buscar.

● Abordar rápido e trazer pro WhatsApp: A rede social é vitrine. O WhatsApp é onde você controla a conversa. Você faz essa ponte em minutos, não em horas.

● Qualificar a necessidade: Entender o que ela quer, qual o momento dela, quais as dúvidas reais. Não é só \"passar informação\" - é descobrir como ajudar ela a decidir.

● Conduzir com estratégia até a consulta PAGA: Você não agenda. Você FECHA. O ciclo só termina quando tem pagamento.

● Confirmar as consultas agendadas: Ligação, mensagem, lembrete. O que for preciso pra garantir que ela apareça. No-show é zero no caixa.

● Follow-up como rotina sagrada:

○ Lead que perguntou e sumiu? Volta nele.

○ Lead que disse \"tá caro\"? Entende a objeção real.

○ Lead que disse \"vou pensar\"? Mantém o relacionamento até ela decidir.

○ Paciente que cancelou? Reagenda.

○ Paciente que fez há 6 meses? Hora da manutenção.

● Trabalhar a base de pacientes existentes: Quem já fez uma vez, volta. Quem gostou, indica. Sua função é ativar isso. Todo dia.

● Manter o CRM organizado em tempo real: Status atualizado, próximo passo definido, histórico completo. Você precisa saber exatamente onde cada lead está no funil.


SEUS INDICADORES DE SUCESSO


O QUE MUDA NO SEU DIA A DIA


Urgência é regra. Seguidor que comentou AGORA precisa ser atendido AGORA. Não daqui a

pouco. Não quando der. AGORA. Lead quente esfria em minutos. A concorrente responde em

segundos. Velocidade é conversão.


O objetivo é consulta PAGA. Vamos deixar claro: agendar não é o objetivo. Faturar é.

Consulta marcada que não acontece é zero no caixa. Consulta marcada que não paga é

prejuízo de tempo. O ciclo só fecha quando a consulta é paga e realizada.


Base de pacientes é ouro. Sabe aquela planilha de pacientes antigos que ninguém mexe?

Isso é dinheiro parado. Cada nome ali é uma mulher que já confiou na clínica, já viu resultado,

já tem relacionamento. Reativar a base é mais fácil que conquistar lead novo. E você vai fazer

isso todo dia.


Follow-up é onde o dinheiro está. A maioria das secretárias manda preço e espera. Você

não. Você entende que \"vou pensar\" não é não - é \"me convença\". Você sabe que quem sumiu

depois do orçamento só precisa do lembrete certo no momento certo. Seu follow-up é o que

separa agenda vazia de agenda lotada.


NÃO É PRA VOCÊ SE:


● Acha follow-up \"chato\" ou \"insistente demais\"

● Manda preço e espera a cliente decidir sozinha

● Tem vergonha de puxar a conversa pra venda

● Acha que responder \"quando der\" é aceitável

● Desaparece no horário de almoço quando os leads estão pipocando

● Vê atendimento como tarefa, não como oportunidade de fechar

● Precisa que alguém fique cobrando pra você fazer follow-up


É PRA VOCÊ SE:


● Entende que cada lead ignorado é dinheiro perdido

● Sente satisfação real quando converte uma conversa difícil

● Faz follow-up naturalmente - não precisa de lembrete

● Age como se cada lead fosse dinheiro do seu bolso

● Tem organização: não deixa nada cair no esquecimento

● Gosta de ritmo intenso e resultado visível

● Entende que vender bem é atender bem


A CANDIDATA DOS SONHOS TEM:


Velocidade: Você não deixa lead esfriar. Chegou, você responde. Ponto.

Fome de resultado: Você quer converter. Quer bater meta. Quer ver o número subir.

Resiliência: \"Vou pensar\" não te desanima. Te dá mais vontade de fazer o follow-up certo.

Organização obsessiva: CRM atualizado, follow-ups no dia certo, zero lead esquecido. Sem precisar de cobrança.

Ownership: Você trata cada lead como se fosse dinheiro do seu bolso. Porque, com comissão, é.

Ritmo: Você aguenta carga intensa. E gosta disso.


A MELHOR PARTE


● Remuneração competitiva: Fixo + comissão por resultado. Quanto mais você converte, mais você ganha.

● Crescimento direto: Seu salário cresce junto com sua performance. Sem teto.

● Ambiente meritocrático: Aqui vale quem gera número, não aparência de trabalho.

● Autonomia total: Liberdade pra conduzir suas conversas e criar suas estratégias. 

● Feedback claro: Você sabe exatamente se está performando ou não. Sem subjetividade.

● Treinamento: Você não vai ser jogada no fogo. Vai aprender o método que funciona.

● Impacto real: Cada consulta que você agenda muda a autoestima de uma mulher.


Se você leu até aqui e pensou \"parece muito trabalho\"... não é pra você. E tá tudo bem.

Se pensou \"finalmente uma vaga que paga por resultado de verdade\"... você é exatamente quem procuramos.

Nos movemos em ritmo acelerado. Apenas candidatas que se destacarem serão contatadas.

Se você não receber contato em 5 dias úteis, infelizmente não foi dessa vez.

Palavras-chave: Secretária comercial, vaga secretária, vaga comercial, atendimento WhatsApp, atendimento Instagram, agendamento de consultas, clínica de estética, harmonização facial, vaga presencial, vaga CLT, vaga PJ, vendas, conversão de leads, follow-up, CRM, recepcionista comercial, atendente comercial, pré-vendas, SDR, closer, inside sales, vaga estética, clínica estética, consultora comercial, assistente comercial, captação de clientes, relacionamento com cliente.
