title: Direct-Response Ad Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Direct-Response Ad Video Editor em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're looking for a direct response video editor who can produce 1-3 performance ads per day — consistently, quickly, and without hand-holding.

You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day.

Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts.

This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements
  • Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll
  • Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build VelorHealth versions
  • Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs
  • Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do
  • Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated TikTok-style captions) depending on the ad format
  • Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing
  • Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours
  • Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates

What You Need

  • Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or TikTok with measurable results)
  • Fluency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in
  • Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native
  • Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught
  • Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography
  • Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought
  • A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly
  • Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed
  • Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person)

Bonus (Not Required)

  • Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space
  • Familiarity with the \"ugly ad\" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production
  • Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation)

What You Don't Need

  • A film degree
  • A fancy reel of cinematic work
  • Experience at a big agency
  • Color grading expertise

We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you.

Compensation

Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work.

How To Apply

There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works:

  • Apply with your portfolio. Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or TikTok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before.
  • If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project. You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired.
  • We evaluate the test on four criteria: Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference?
  • Did the first frame stop the scroll?
  • Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO?
  • Did you deliver on time?
  • If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output.

We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut.


To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line \"DR Editor — (Your Name).\"

title: Data Product Associate
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Product Associate em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About YipitData:

YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare.

Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact.

We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency.

With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.


About the Role:

We currently have 60+ Data team members in our Investor business who build, create and maintain our data products, and we are looking to further expand the team to continue to increase our product portfolio. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply.

At YipitData, we value ownership and impact. Your growth is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Our career ladder also rewards strong performance with regular opportunities for compensation increases and promotions.

See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current data team members love working here!


As a Data Associate, you will:

  • Own high-impact data products end-to-end — driving product success by delivering best-in-class outputs with a focus on accuracy, client value, and efficiency. You’ll ramp quickly into full ownership of your products and workflows, operating with minimal oversight.
  • Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies and datasets we analyze. You’ll develop deep expertise in our proprietary methods and techniques, building strong mental models that allow you to ensure data accuracy, identify methodology gaps, and derive key insights.
  • Tackle complex data problems independently , using strong analytical judgment to refine methodologies, test new datasets, and solve challenges that require innovative thinking — even when information is incomplete or ambiguous.
  • Use AI and tooling to drive meaningful leverage — significantly increasing speed, reducing manual work, and beginning to automate portions of workflows. You’ll standardize best practices and build repeatable processes, always maintaining a high bar for correctness and quality while validating AI-generated outputs.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Research, Engineering, and other teams — coordinating across functions to unblock work, align on best practices, and develop technical solutions that streamline workflows, optimize data processes, and push the boundaries of automation.
  • Identify and drive improvements to products and data pipelines , contributing ideas for new products, enhancements, and features. This could include developing new methodologies, exploring and scaling the use of new third-party datasets, or improving product profitability — all with a clear understanding of what drives value for clients.


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have 4–5+ years of experience in data, business, or predictive analytics and are proficient in SQL, Python, and PySpark
  • You have a proven track record of quickly learning new concepts, particularly complex data methodologies, and building strong mental models of how and why data works
  • You actively use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate your work and are excited about using AI to drive leverage — not just productivity, but fundamentally better and faster ways of working
  • You can clearly communicate complex concepts — including methodology, risks, and tradeoffs — both orally and in writing
  • You have a strong ownership mentality and are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company
  • You can manage multiple projects simultaneously, independently prioritize tasks, and make sound decisions with incomplete information
  • You have experience using sample or panel data to make precise estimates that guide decision-making
  • You have a background in financial markets or are interested in learning more about data-driven investing
  • You have an Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)


For You:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Operations Manager (Product)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Operations Manager (Product) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We’re looking for a Product Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You’ll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you’ll be doing

  • Developing a point of view on specific fintech verticals and defining a cohesive long-term strategy for the company and product departments
  • Acting as the eyes and ears of the company, feeding information from the market back into company strategy and department roadmaps
  • Tracking and analysing competitive position and product performance globally
  • Helping scope and launch new verticals for the company
  • Defining initial product proposition and go-to-market strategies for new expansion markets

What you'll need

  • At least a 2:1 degree from a top university
  • A STEM or other highly quantitative degree from a top-tier university
  • A track record of outstanding achievement in different areas
  • 3+ years of experience in a strategy consulting, investment banking/PE/VC, or fast-growing technology company in a product or strategy role
  • Great problem-solving skills
  • A focus on customer-centric designs and solutions

Nice to have

  • A track record of building successful products (ideally financial) using data, customer feedback, common sense, and/or machine learning

Compensation range

  • Krakow: PLN19,500 - PLN21,600 gross monthly*
  • Poland: PLN19,500 - PLN21,600 gross monthly*
  • Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process

*Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you.

Compensation

Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work.

How To Apply

There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works:

  • Apply with your portfolio. Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or TikTok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before.
  • If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project. You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired.
  • We evaluate the test on four criteria: Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference?
  • Did the first frame stop the scroll?
  • Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO?
  • Did you deliver on time?
  • If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output.

We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut.


To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line \"DR Editor — (Your Name).\"

We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only: Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery.

As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R&D, Product, and Growth) across the U.S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia.   • High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery: Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via , regional job boards, GitHub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing.
  • HQ & Candidate Facilitation: Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact.
  • Data & Pipeline Transparency: Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast.


The DNA We Are Looking For-

The Baseline (Hard Skills):

  • Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese): Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages. You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese.
  • Proven Recruitment Engine: 2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus.
  • Geographic Flexibility: Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U.S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset.


Core Traits (Soft Skills):

  • The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine: You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions.
  • Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails: You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack.


What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face

What You Will Get:

  • Uncapped Earning Potential: On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn.
  • The Global Flex-Work Playbook: Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network.
  • A Trusted Extension of the Crew: No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind.


The Challenges You Will Face:

  • 100% Remote Coordination: Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule.
  • Embracing Ambiguity: Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts.


If you are a bilingual recruitment hustler who is ready to deliver global talent and write your own paycheck via performance bonuses, let’s talk. Apply now and let’s make a global impact together!

  • Support revenue growth by improving sales execution, operational follow-through, and conversion from meetings to closed business. 


Required Skills  


  • 10+ years of senior sales or commercial leadership experience . 
  • Experience working with the U.S. market or U.S.-based clients . 
  • Strong sales and revenue mindset, with the ability to own opportunities from qualified lead to close. 
  • Experience managing sales pipelines, client follow-up, and deal progression. 
  • Strong CRM discipline, including accurate pipeline tracking and clear next-step management. 
  • Ability to coordinate across multiple internal teams and hold stakeholders accountable. 
  • Strong communication skills with both clients and internal team members. 
  • Ability to identify stalled deals, operational gaps, or risks and take action to move things forward. 
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment where priorities may shift.

Nice-to-Have Skills

Compensation Range

title: Tech Lead - Java
description:

O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um/uma Tech Lead para integrar nossa equipe de desenvolvimento. Quem ocupar essa posição desempenhará um papel crucial na liderança técnica, garantindo a entrega contínua de valor por meio da otimização do fluxo de valor (Value Stream) e da implementação de soluções de alta qualidade que estejam alinhadas aos objetivos de negócios dos nossos clientes.

  • Planejamento e design técnico: Lidera o planejamento e o design técnico de projetos de integração e API, garantindo a aplicação de melhores práticas, reutilização e escalabilidade. Isto inclui a definição da arquitetura do sistema, a seleção de tecnologias e ferramentas e a identificação de riscos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Entrega contínua de valor: Monitora e otimize o fluxo de trabalho da equipe, garantindo a entrega contínua de valor para os clientes e partes interessadas, coordenando práticas de CI/CD e automação para otimizar o processo de desenvolvimento e entrega.

Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e design de APIs, incluindo o uso de padrões como REST, SOAP e gRPC.
  • Domínio em arquitetura de sistemas e design de software, incluindo padrões de design, microserviços e arquitetura orientada a eventos.

  • Conhecimento em práticas de CI/CD (Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua) e ferramentas associadas, como Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, CircleCI e Travis CI.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento de software, como Scrum e Kanban, e experiência na aplicação de princípios Lean no gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Domínio em automação de testes e ferramentas de garantia de qualidade, como Selenium, JUnit, TestNG e outras.

title: Direct-Response Ad Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Direct-Response Ad Video Editor em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're looking for a direct response video editor who can produce 1-3 performance ads per day — consistently, quickly, and without hand-holding.

You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day.

Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts.

This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements
  • Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll
  • Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build VelorHealth versions
  • Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs
  • Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do
  • Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated TikTok-style captions) depending on the ad format
  • Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing
  • Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours
  • Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates

What You Need

  • Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or TikTok with measurable results)
  • Fluency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in
  • Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native
  • Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught
  • Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography
  • Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought
  • A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly
  • Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed
  • Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person)

Bonus (Not Required)

  • Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space
  • Familiarity with the \"ugly ad\" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production
  • Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation)

What You Don't Need

  • A film degree
  • A fancy reel of cinematic work
  • Experience at a big agency
  • Color grading expertise

We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you.

Compensation

Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work.

How To Apply

There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works:

  • Apply with your portfolio. Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or TikTok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before.
  • If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project. You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired.
  • We evaluate the test on four criteria: Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference?
  • Did the first frame stop the scroll?
  • Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO?
  • Did you deliver on time?
  • If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output.

We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut.


To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line \"DR Editor — (Your Name).\"

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Java Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A VMetrix é uma plataforma SaaS que atende instituições financeiras na América Latina. Processamos fluxos transacionais complexos, pipelines de dados de alto volume e integrações em tempo real — tudo construído sobre uma stack Java/Spring Boot + Oracle implantada na Oracle Cloud. Buscamos desenvolvedores Java sólidos que escrevam código excelente, pensem em sistemas e adotem o desenvolvimento assistido por IA como parte central do seu fluxo de trabalho.


Propósito do Cargo

Como Senior Java Developer , você vai construir e manter serviços backend e módulos de plataforma que suportam operações críticas de negócio. Você não precisa de experiência prévia no domínio financeiro — nós ensinamos. O que precisamos é de um desenvolvedor que escreva Java limpo e performante, domine padrões de design, entenda sistemas distribuídos e use ferramentas como Claude Code para se mover rápido sem sacrificar qualidade.


Responsabilidades Principais:

Desenvolvimento Backend

  • Projetar, construir e manter serviços backend em Java 8+/Spring Boot: APIs REST, jobs de processamento batch, pipelines de transformação de dados e camadas de integração.
  • Escrever código limpo, bem testado e pronto para produção, aplicando princípios SOLID, padrões de design (Strategy, Factory, Observer, Builder, Template Method, entre outros) e as diretrizes arquiteturais da equipe.
  • Ser dono de features end-to-end: desde o design técnico até a implementação, testes, code review e deploy em produção.
  • Otimizar o desempenho de aplicações: identificar e resolver gargalos em queries, chamadas a serviços, uso de memória e throughput.
  • Aplicar corretamente padrões de concorrência e gerenciamento de threads em Java para operações paralelas e assíncronas.


Design e Arquitetura

  • Participar de decisões de design de software: seleção de padrões, definição de contratos entre componentes, separação de responsabilidades e modelagem de domínios.
  • Aplicar princípios de design orientado a objetos (encapsulamento, herança, composição, polimorfismo) e design por contrato na construção de módulos.
  • Contribuir para o design de arquiteturas limpas: separação de camadas (controller, service, repository), injeção de dependências, inversão de controle e baixo acoplamento entre módulos.
  • Avaliar trade-offs técnicos entre diferentes abordagens de design, documentando decisões e suas justificativas.


Banco de Dados e Integrações

  • Trabalhar com Oracle Database: escrever e otimizar consultas SQL, stored procedures e packages PL/SQL para operações intensivas em dados.
  • Construir e manter integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST, cobrindo ingestão, transformação e sincronização de dados.
  • Projetar padrões de acesso a dados eficientes usando JPA/Hibernate ou JDBC, com atenção a gerenciamento de conexões, cache de entidades e limites transacionais.
  • Implementar estratégias de resiliência em integrações: retentativas, circuit breakers, timeouts e tratamento gracioso de falhas.


Infraestrutura e Deploy

  • Implantar e gerenciar aplicações em Kubernetes (OKE) com contêineres Docker e servidor de aplicações WebLogic.
  • Trabalhar com pipelines CI/CD (GitLab CI ou similar) para fluxos automatizados de build, teste e deployment.
  • Diagnosticar problemas em produção: analisar logs, métricas de aplicação e comportamento do sistema para resolver incidentes.


Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA

  • Usar Claude Code como ferramenta principal de desenvolvimento: geração de código, refatoração, debugging, escrita de testes e exploração de codebases desconhecidos.
  • Escrever e manter documentação técnica em Markdown que sirva como contexto de alta qualidade tanto para ferramentas de IA quanto para a equipe.
  • Aplicar habilidades de engenharia de prompts: decompor problemas complexos em prompts claros e acionáveis, avaliando criticamente as saídas geradas por IA.
  • Contribuir para as práticas de desenvolvimento com IA da equipe: compartilhar padrões eficazes, identificar limitações e ajudar a estabelecer melhores práticas.


Colaboração e Crescimento

  • Participar de revisões de código com feedback construtivo e rigoroso, focado em corretude, legibilidade, padrões e manutenibilidade.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores junior através de pair programming, discussões de design e transferência de conhecimento.
  • Contribuir para discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura, ferramentas e melhorias de processos.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas.
  • 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento Java.
  • Domínio sólido de Java 8+ (streams, lambdas, concorrência, collections, Optional, API de data/hora) e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, segurança, Spring Data, testes).
  • Conhecimento sólido de padrões de design GoF (criacionais, estruturais, comportamentais) e capacidade de aplicá-los corretamente conforme o contexto do problema.
  • Domínio dos princípios SOLID, DRY, KISS e YAGNI na prática diária de desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência com design orientado a objetos: modelagem de domínios, composição vs herança, encapsulamento, tratamento de exceções e design de APIs internas claras.
  • Habilidades sólidas em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais: otimização de queries, estratégias de indexação, joins complexos, gerenciamento transacional. Experiência com Oracle é um diferencial forte.
  • Experiência com estratégias de testes: testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito), testes de integração, test doubles e TDD ou BDD como prática habitual.
  • Experiência com deploys em contêineres: Docker, Kubernetes (qualquer distribuição), pipelines CI/CD.
  • Familiaridade com fluxos Git (Git Flow ou trunk-based), Postman/OpenAPI para desenvolvimento de APIs.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA — especialmente Claude Code. Esperamos que você use IA diariamente como multiplicador de produtividade, não como muleta.
  • Comunicação escrita sólida: capacidade de produzir specs técnicos claros, documentos de design e descrições de PR.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com Oracle PL/SQL: stored procedures, pipelined functions, performance tuning.
  • Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura: caching (Caffeine/Redis), arquitetura event-driven, design metadata-driven, CQRS.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços ou modular monolith: estratégias de comunicação entre serviços, gerenciamento de transações distribuídas, contract testing.
  • Familiaridade com Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture ou Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade: Grafana, Prometheus, métricas de aplicação, agregação de logs.
  • Familiaridade com servidor de aplicações WebLogic ou runtimes Java empresariais similares.
  • Experiência trabalhando em plataformas SaaS ou sistemas multi-tenant.
  • Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações técnicas equivalentes.


O Que Valorizamos:

  • Qualidade acima de velocidade: preferimos entregar código limpo e bem testado um dia depois do que debugar um desastre por uma semana.
  • Fluência com IA: você vê Claude Code e ferramentas similares como partes essenciais do seu toolkit, não como novidades. Sabe quando confiar no output e quando questioná-lo.
  • Critério de design: você não aplica padrões por inércia — sabe quando um Strategy simplifica e quando um if-else é suficiente. Prioriza clareza acima de cleverness.
  • Pensamento sistêmico: considera os efeitos downstream das suas decisões de design em desempenho, manutenibilidade e velocidade da equipe.
  • Ownership: leva suas features do design até produção e se importa com como seu código se comporta no mundo real.
  • Curiosidade: se mantém atualizado com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento, e tem interesse genuíno em evoluir no seu ofício.
  • Comunicação clara: escreve documentação que seus colegas de equipe (e as ferramentas de IA) realmente conseguem usar.


Processo de Candidatura:

  • Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo LinkedIn.
  • Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo.
  • Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência.
  • Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não.


Por que trabalhar na VMetrix

Na VMetrix , não buscamos “fazer mais barulho”, mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva.

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Java Developer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A VMetrix é uma plataforma SaaS que atende instituições financeiras na América Latina. Processamos fluxos transacionais complexos, pipelines de dados de alto volume e integrações em tempo real — tudo construído sobre uma stack Java/Spring Boot + Oracle implantada na Oracle Cloud. Buscamos desenvolvedores Java sólidos que escrevam código excelente, pensem em sistemas e adotem o desenvolvimento assistido por IA como parte central do seu fluxo de trabalho.


Propósito do Cargo

Como Senior Java Developer , você vai construir e manter serviços backend e módulos de plataforma que suportam operações críticas de negócio. Você não precisa de experiência prévia no domínio financeiro — nós ensinamos. O que precisamos é de um desenvolvedor que escreva Java limpo e performante, domine padrões de design, entenda sistemas distribuídos e use ferramentas como Claude Code para se mover rápido sem sacrificar qualidade.


Responsabilidades Principais:

Desenvolvimento Backend

  • Projetar, construir e manter serviços backend em Java 8+/Spring Boot: APIs REST, jobs de processamento batch, pipelines de transformação de dados e camadas de integração.
  • Escrever código limpo, bem testado e pronto para produção, aplicando princípios SOLID, padrões de design (Strategy, Factory, Observer, Builder, Template Method, entre outros) e as diretrizes arquiteturais da equipe.
  • Ser dono de features end-to-end: desde o design técnico até a implementação, testes, code review e deploy em produção.
  • Otimizar o desempenho de aplicações: identificar e resolver gargalos em queries, chamadas a serviços, uso de memória e throughput.
  • Aplicar corretamente padrões de concorrência e gerenciamento de threads em Java para operações paralelas e assíncronas.


Design e Arquitetura

  • Participar de decisões de design de software: seleção de padrões, definição de contratos entre componentes, separação de responsabilidades e modelagem de domínios.
  • Aplicar princípios de design orientado a objetos (encapsulamento, herança, composição, polimorfismo) e design por contrato na construção de módulos.
  • Contribuir para o design de arquiteturas limpas: separação de camadas (controller, service, repository), injeção de dependências, inversão de controle e baixo acoplamento entre módulos.
  • Avaliar trade-offs técnicos entre diferentes abordagens de design, documentando decisões e suas justificativas.


Banco de Dados e Integrações

  • Trabalhar com Oracle Database: escrever e otimizar consultas SQL, stored procedures e packages PL/SQL para operações intensivas em dados.
  • Construir e manter integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST, cobrindo ingestão, transformação e sincronização de dados.
  • Projetar padrões de acesso a dados eficientes usando JPA/Hibernate ou JDBC, com atenção a gerenciamento de conexões, cache de entidades e limites transacionais.
  • Implementar estratégias de resiliência em integrações: retentativas, circuit breakers, timeouts e tratamento gracioso de falhas.


Infraestrutura e Deploy

  • Implantar e gerenciar aplicações em Kubernetes (OKE) com contêineres Docker e servidor de aplicações WebLogic.
  • Trabalhar com pipelines CI/CD (GitLab CI ou similar) para fluxos automatizados de build, teste e deployment.
  • Diagnosticar problemas em produção: analisar logs, métricas de aplicação e comportamento do sistema para resolver incidentes.


Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA

  • Usar Claude Code como ferramenta principal de desenvolvimento: geração de código, refatoração, debugging, escrita de testes e exploração de codebases desconhecidos.
  • Escrever e manter documentação técnica em Markdown que sirva como contexto de alta qualidade tanto para ferramentas de IA quanto para a equipe.
  • Aplicar habilidades de engenharia de prompts: decompor problemas complexos em prompts claros e acionáveis, avaliando criticamente as saídas geradas por IA.
  • Contribuir para as práticas de desenvolvimento com IA da equipe: compartilhar padrões eficazes, identificar limitações e ajudar a estabelecer melhores práticas.


Colaboração e Crescimento

  • Participar de revisões de código com feedback construtivo e rigoroso, focado em corretude, legibilidade, padrões e manutenibilidade.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores junior através de pair programming, discussões de design e transferência de conhecimento.
  • Contribuir para discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura, ferramentas e melhorias de processos.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas.
  • 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento Java.
  • Domínio sólido de Java 8+ (streams, lambdas, concorrência, collections, Optional, API de data/hora) e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, segurança, Spring Data, testes).
  • Conhecimento sólido de padrões de design GoF (criacionais, estruturais, comportamentais) e capacidade de aplicá-los corretamente conforme o contexto do problema.
  • Domínio dos princípios SOLID, DRY, KISS e YAGNI na prática diária de desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência com design orientado a objetos: modelagem de domínios, composição vs herança, encapsulamento, tratamento de exceções e design de APIs internas claras.
  • Habilidades sólidas em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais: otimização de queries, estratégias de indexação, joins complexos, gerenciamento transacional. Experiência com Oracle é um diferencial forte.
  • Experiência com estratégias de testes: testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito), testes de integração, test doubles e TDD ou BDD como prática habitual.
  • Experiência com deploys em contêineres: Docker, Kubernetes (qualquer distribuição), pipelines CI/CD.
  • Familiaridade com fluxos Git (Git Flow ou trunk-based), Postman/OpenAPI para desenvolvimento de APIs.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA — especialmente Claude Code. Esperamos que você use IA diariamente como multiplicador de produtividade, não como muleta.
  • Comunicação escrita sólida: capacidade de produzir specs técnicos claros, documentos de design e descrições de PR.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com Oracle PL/SQL: stored procedures, pipelined functions, performance tuning.
  • Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura: caching (Caffeine/Redis), arquitetura event-driven, design metadata-driven, CQRS.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços ou modular monolith: estratégias de comunicação entre serviços, gerenciamento de transações distribuídas, contract testing.
  • Familiaridade com Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture ou Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade: Grafana, Prometheus, métricas de aplicação, agregação de logs.
  • Familiaridade com servidor de aplicações WebLogic ou runtimes Java empresariais similares.
  • Experiência trabalhando em plataformas SaaS ou sistemas multi-tenant.
  • Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações técnicas equivalentes.


O Que Valorizamos:

  • Qualidade acima de velocidade: preferimos entregar código limpo e bem testado um dia depois do que debugar um desastre por uma semana.
  • Fluência com IA: você vê Claude Code e ferramentas similares como partes essenciais do seu toolkit, não como novidades. Sabe quando confiar no output e quando questioná-lo.
  • Critério de design: você não aplica padrões por inércia — sabe quando um Strategy simplifica e quando um if-else é suficiente. Prioriza clareza acima de cleverness.
  • Pensamento sistêmico: considera os efeitos downstream das suas decisões de design em desempenho, manutenibilidade e velocidade da equipe.
  • Ownership: leva suas features do design até produção e se importa com como seu código se comporta no mundo real.
  • Curiosidade: se mantém atualizado com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento, e tem interesse genuíno em evoluir no seu ofício.
  • Comunicação clara: escreve documentação que seus colegas de equipe (e as ferramentas de IA) realmente conseguem usar.


Processo de Candidatura:

  • Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo LinkedIn.
  • Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo.
  • Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência.
  • Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não.


Por que trabalhar na VMetrix

Na VMetrix , não buscamos “fazer mais barulho”, mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva.

Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional.

Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix é o lugar.

title: Data Product Associate
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Product Associate em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About YipitData:

YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare.

Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact.

We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency.

With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.


About the Role:

We currently have 60+ Data team members in our Investor business who build, create and maintain our data products, and we are looking to further expand the team to continue to increase our product portfolio. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply.

At YipitData, we value ownership and impact. Your growth is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Our career ladder also rewards strong performance with regular opportunities for compensation increases and promotions.

See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current data team members love working here!


As a Data Associate, you will:

  • Own high-impact data products end-to-end — driving product success by delivering best-in-class outputs with a focus on accuracy, client value, and efficiency. You’ll ramp quickly into full ownership of your products and workflows, operating with minimal oversight.
  • Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies and datasets we analyze. You’ll develop deep expertise in our proprietary methods and techniques, building strong mental models that allow you to ensure data accuracy, identify methodology gaps, and derive key insights.
  • Tackle complex data problems independently , using strong analytical judgment to refine methodologies, test new datasets, and solve challenges that require innovative thinking — even when information is incomplete or ambiguous.
  • Use AI and tooling to drive meaningful leverage — significantly increasing speed, reducing manual work, and beginning to automate portions of workflows. You’ll standardize best practices and build repeatable processes, always maintaining a high bar for correctness and quality while validating AI-generated outputs.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Research, Engineering, and other teams — coordinating across functions to unblock work, align on best practices, and develop technical solutions that streamline workflows, optimize data processes, and push the boundaries of automation.
  • Identify and drive improvements to products and data pipelines , contributing ideas for new products, enhancements, and features. This could include developing new methodologies, exploring and scaling the use of new third-party datasets, or improving product profitability — all with a clear understanding of what drives value for clients.


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have 4–5+ years of experience in data, business, or predictive analytics and are proficient in SQL, Python, and PySpark
  • You have a proven track record of quickly learning new concepts, particularly complex data methodologies, and building strong mental models of how and why data works
  • You actively use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate your work and are excited about using AI to drive leverage — not just productivity, but fundamentally better and faster ways of working
  • You can clearly communicate complex concepts — including methodology, risks, and tradeoffs — both orally and in writing
  • You have a strong ownership mentality and are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company
  • You can manage multiple projects simultaneously, independently prioritize tasks, and make sound decisions with incomplete information
  • You have experience using sample or panel data to make precise estimates that guide decision-making
  • You have a background in financial markets or are interested in learning more about data-driven investing
  • You have an Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)


For You:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Tech Lead - Java
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Tech Lead - Java em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:


  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um/uma Tech Lead para integrar nossa equipe de desenvolvimento. Quem ocupar essa posição desempenhará um papel crucial na liderança técnica, garantindo a entrega contínua de valor por meio da otimização do fluxo de valor (Value Stream) e da implementação de soluções de alta qualidade que estejam alinhadas aos objetivos de negócios dos nossos clientes.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


  • Liderança técnica: Fornece liderança e orientação técnica à equipe de desenvolvimento, estabelecendo padrões de qualidade, aderindo às melhores práticas e garantindo a implementação de soluções técnicas eficientes e escaláveis.
  • Compreensão do fluxo de valor: Trabalha com gerentes de produto, analistas de negócios, arquitetos e desenvolvedores para entender o fluxo de valor completo, desde a concepção da ideia até a entrega do produto, identificando áreas de melhoria e reduzindo desperdícios no processo.
  • Colaboração com equipes multifuncionais: Trabalha em estreita colaboração com gerentes de produto, analistas de negócios, arquitetos e desenvolvedores para entender as necessidades dos negócios, traduzi-las em requisitos técnicos e garantir que as soluções propostas estejam alinhadas com os objetivos gerais do projeto e do cliente.
  • Gerenciamento de projetos e entregas: Monitora o progresso dos projetos, identifique gargalos e proponha soluções para garantir que os prazos e os padrões de qualidade sejam cumpridos. Além disso, coordene a implementação de práticas de CI/CD e automação para otimizar o processo de desenvolvimento e entrega.
  • Planejamento e design técnico: Lidera o planejamento e o design técnico de projetos de integração e API, garantindo a aplicação de melhores práticas, reutilização e escalabilidade. Isto inclui a definição da arquitetura do sistema, a seleção de tecnologias e ferramentas e a identificação de riscos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Entrega contínua de valor: Monitora e otimize o fluxo de trabalho da equipe, garantindo a entrega contínua de valor para os clientes e partes interessadas, coordenando práticas de CI/CD e automação para otimizar o processo de desenvolvimento e entrega.
  • Desenvolvimento e revisão de código : Desenvolve acompanha o desenvolvimento de integrações e APIs, fornecendo orientações técnicas e conduzindo revisões de código para garantir a qualidade e a aderência às normas e práticas recomendadas.
  • Mentoria e desenvolvimento da equipe: Promove o crescimento e o desenvolvimento da equipe de desenvolvimento por meio de mentoria, compartilhamento de conhecimento e promoção de um ambiente de aprendizado contínuo. Isso inclui a realização de sessões de treinamento, fornecendo feedback construtivo e apoiando a resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Medição e melhoria de resultados: Utiliza métricas e indicadores relevantes para avaliar o sucesso das soluções entregues, identificar áreas de melhoria e garantir a satisfação das partes interessadas.
  • Comunicação e apresentação de resultados: Comunica-se efetivamente com as partes interessadas em todos os níveis da organização, incluindo a apresentação de resultados, o compartilhamento de atualizações de projetos e a discussão de questões técnicas e de negócios.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:


  • Conhecimento sólido em linguagens de programação e frameworks relevantes para o domínio do projeto (por exemplo: Java, .NET, JavaScript, Python, etc.), com experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos e soluções em ambientes empresariais
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e design de APIs, incluindo o uso de padrões como REST, SOAP e gRPC.
  • Domínio em arquitetura de sistemas e design de software, incluindo padrões de design, microserviços e arquitetura orientada a eventos.
  • Experiência com práticas de integração de sistemas, como ESB (Enterprise Service Bus), SOA (Arquitetura Orientada a Serviços) e iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service).
  • Proficiência em bancos de dados e sistemas de gerenciamento de bancos de dados (SQL e NoSQL), bem como em tecnologias de armazenamento e recuperação de dados.
  • Conhecimento em práticas de CI/CD (Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua) e ferramentas associadas, como Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, CircleCI e Travis CI.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento de software, como Scrum e Kanban, e experiência na aplicação de princípios Lean no gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Domínio em automação de testes e ferramentas de garantia de qualidade, como Selenium, JUnit, TestNG e outras.
  • Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações e APIs, incluindo autenticação, autorização, criptografia e conformidade com regulamentações e padrões relevantes.
  • Experiência em gerenciamento de infraestrutura e serviços em nuvem, como AWS, Azure e Google Cloud Platform.
  • Capacidade de analisar e solucionar problemas de desempenho e escalabilidade, aplicando técnicas de otimização e monitoramento de aplicativos.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.

title: Inside Sales Account Executive, North America
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Inside Sales Account Executive, North America em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: anywhere in LATAM


JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are looking for dedicated sales professionals to drive adoption of our product at universities and colleges in North America. An ideal candidate is a result-oriented achiever, who is effective in a remote work environment and strives to succeed and grow with the company.


Responsibilities :

title: Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer


Job Purpose

As Senior Windows Infrastructure Engineer, you are the technical anchor for the Windows estate that powers the managed services platform — a multi-client environment hosted on AWS. The work is grounded in deep Windows Server operations: Active Directory, IIS, hybrid identity, Group Policy, PowerShell, certificate services, and the wider Microsoft ecosystem.


AWS is the platform on which all of this runs. Comfort with the cloud layer matters and you will operate it daily, but it is the Microsoft stack — and its operational nuance — that defines this role. We hire for deep Windows expertise first; the cloud layer is something a strong sysadmin can absorb.


The estate is Windows Server 2019 and above, end-to-end. Linux footprint is negligible — this is a role for someone who wants to go deep on the Microsoft stack rather than be spread thin across platforms.


This is a 100% individual contributor role. You will not manage or lead a team. You will own complex incidents end-to-end, set technical standards by example, and act as the senior escalation point for the Cloud Support function.


Role Responsibilities

  • Lead resolution of complex Windows Server incidents across multi-client, AWS-hosted environments — from triage to root cause to remediation.
  • Administer and harden Windows Server 2019/2022/2025: Active Directory (forest/domain design, replication, FSMO, GPOs, trusts), DNS, DHCP, IIS, WSUS, AD CS, file & print services.
  • Operate hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ AWS Managed Microsoft AD, federation with Entra ID (Azure AD) / AD FS, SAML / OIDC / OAuth, Kerberos, MFA.
  • Author and maintain PowerShell automation: bulk administration, scheduled tasks, configuration drift correction, reporting, and DSC where appropriate.
  • Operate the AWS hosting layer for Windows workloads: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch, Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command), Backup, Directory Service.
  • Manage IIS in depth: sites, application pools, bindings, ARR / URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, and performance tuning.
  • Drive observability of the Windows estate: event log strategy, performance baselines, CloudWatch metrics & alarms, Grafana dashboards.
  • Author runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles to codify operational standards.
  • Participate in ITIL incident, problem, and change management; act as senior on-call escalation.


Essential Skills & Experience

Windows Server & Microsoft Infrastructure (Primary)

  • 7+ years operating Windows Server in production, with deep hands-on experience on Windows Server 2019 and above.
  • Active Directory at depth: forest/domain design, replication, FSMO roles, trusts, sites & services, schema, tombstone & recovery.
  • Group Policy at scale: design, troubleshooting (RSoP, gpresult), security baselines, WMI filtering.
  • IIS at depth: site & app pool configuration, ARR, URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, performance tuning.
  • DNS, DHCP, WSUS, and Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) — real operational experience.
  • Advanced PowerShell: scripting, modules, remoting, error handling, automation patterns, DSC familiarity.
  • Windows patching at scale: planning, deployment, rollback, and troubleshooting in regulated environments.
  • Windows performance troubleshooting: PerfMon, ETW, memory dump analysis, IIS request diagnostics.

Identity & Authentication

  • Hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ cloud, Entra ID (Azure AD) Connect / federation, AD FS.
  • SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, Kerberos, LDAP, MFA — practical implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Certificate management and PKI in enterprise Windows environments.

AWS Hosting Platform (Operational Competence)

  • Day-to-day comfort operating Windows workloads in AWS: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch.
  • AWS Systems Manager for Windows fleet management: Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command, State Manager, Parameter Store.
  • AWS Directory Service / Managed Microsoft AD / AD Connector.

Note: Deep AWS architect-level expertise is not required. We hire for Windows depth; the cloud layer is the platform, and we expect strong fundamentals plus willingness to grow.

Service Operations & Remote Working

  • Strong ITIL grounding: incident, problem, change, and service lifecycle management.
  • Prior experience in an MSP or shared-services environment — multiple client estates managed under SLA.
  • Advanced / fluent professional English, written and spoken.
  • Reliable, distraction-free home office with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video setup.
  • Ability to work New York-aligned hours consistently, with the same presence and responsiveness as an office-based colleague.

Working Hours, Remote Setup & Engagement

This role is 100% remote and 100% individual contributor. To match the responsiveness of an office-based engineer:

  • Working hours: You will operate aligned to New York business hours (08:30–17:30 ET). Typical Brazil hours: 09:30–18:30 BRT during EDT (US summer) and 10:30–19:30 BRT during EST (US winter). You must be online, responsive, and actively engaged throughout core hours, the same as if you were sat with the team in the office.
  • Home office: Quiet, ergonomic workspace with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video / audio setup. This is not a digital-nomad role.
  • Engagement model: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) or via Employer of Record — confirmed during recruitment. Tax, invoicing, and benefits arrangements discussed at offer stage.

title: LATAM / Senior Functional Infrastructure Engineer (TypeScript / Integrations)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para LATAM / Senior Functional Infrastructure Engineer (TypeScript / Integrations) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Description

We are hiring a Senior Functional Backend Engineer to help us connect to insurance portals across the U.S. to ingest, transform, and deliver structured healthcare data, including claims, EOBs, plan documents, and accumulators.


This role sits at the intersection of production reliability and system design . You’ll own integration health in production, onboard new portals, expand data coverage, and write clean, strongly typed backend code. The team values functional principles such as composability, explicit error handling, type safety, and uses Effect extensively, but prior experience with Effect is not required.


This is hands-on engineering in a system where correctness and clarity matter.


English fluency is a MUST for this role! Only candidates with level C1 or C2 will be considered:


A1 Beginner

A2 Elementary

B1 Intermediate

B2 Upper-Intermediate

C1 Advanced

C2 Proficient


Responsibilities
  • Production Triage & Reliability
  • Own first-response triage for portal integration failures
  • Debug login automation issues, crawl failures, and ingestion errors
  • Trace failures across logs, workflows, and monitoring systems
  • Implement clean, durable fixes - not just patches
  • Escalate systemic platform issues when appropriate
  • Portal Onboarding
  • Bring new insurance portals into production
  • Reverse-engineer APIs and browser workflows
  • Build ingestion pipelines and validate structured outputs
  • Ensure integrations remain resilient as portals evolve
  • Data Expansion  
  • Extend existing integrations to capture new data types
  • Maintain strong typing and predictable transformations
  • Guard against schema drift and data inconsistencies
  • Collaboration
  • Contribute to runbooks and documentation
  • Participate in async standups and structured handoffs
  • Work closely with a platform-focused engineering team


Requirements
  • 4+ years of Strongly Typed Backend Experience  
  • Deep experience in strongly typed languages (TypeScript , Scala, Kotlin , Go, etc.)
  • Careful API modeling and schema validation
  • Comfort designing systems where types act as contracts
  • Functional or Declarative Programming Experience  
  • You don’t need to come from a pure Functional Programming background, but you should be comfortable with immutability, explicit handling, declarative composition, and writing predictable, testable code.
  • AI Integration Experience: Accelerate developers and internal operations by exposing or configuring API and MCP access to our infrastructure, while keeping costs and security under control.
  • CI/CD Operations Experience: Ability to improve GitHub Actions workflows, implement faster CI runners, enhance caching strategies, and manage multi-environment deployments (dev/prod) using Pulumi
  • Infrastructure Management with AWS: Maintain AWS infrastructure including ECS, Aurora RDS (Gel), VPC networking, and monitoring stack (OpenTelemetry, Honeycomb, Sentry → but soon Datadog), and AWS access provisioning
  • TypeScript (Backend)
  • Enhance our TypeScript monorepo performance, optimize the Nx build system, migrate from CommonJS to ESM, and improve our Docker-based DevContainers


Nice To Have
  • Experience with Effect
  • Experience with Effect is a strong plus
  • If not, you should be comfortable learning it and working within a composable, typed effect system
  • Playwright or browser automation
  • API reverse-engineering via browser devtools
  • Workflow orchestration (Temporal or similar)
  • Data ingestion or transformation pipelines
  • Observability tooling (Datadog or similar)
  • MDM & Security & Compliance: Support HIPAA compliance initiatives, including RBAC implementation, encryption standards, and security monitoring
  • Experience in the Healthcare industry in the USA

title: Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer


Job Purpose

As Senior Windows Infrastructure Engineer, you are the technical anchor for the Windows estate that powers the managed services platform — a multi-client environment hosted on AWS. The work is grounded in deep Windows Server operations: Active Directory, IIS, hybrid identity, Group Policy, PowerShell, certificate services, and the wider Microsoft ecosystem.


AWS is the platform on which all of this runs. Comfort with the cloud layer matters and you will operate it daily, but it is the Microsoft stack — and its operational nuance — that defines this role. We hire for deep Windows expertise first; the cloud layer is something a strong sysadmin can absorb.


The estate is Windows Server 2019 and above, end-to-end. Linux footprint is negligible — this is a role for someone who wants to go deep on the Microsoft stack rather than be spread thin across platforms.


This is a 100% individual contributor role. You will not manage or lead a team. You will own complex incidents end-to-end, set technical standards by example, and act as the senior escalation point for the Cloud Support function.


Role Responsibilities

  • Lead resolution of complex Windows Server incidents across multi-client, AWS-hosted environments — from triage to root cause to remediation.
  • Administer and harden Windows Server 2019/2022/2025: Active Directory (forest/domain design, replication, FSMO, GPOs, trusts), DNS, DHCP, IIS, WSUS, AD CS, file & print services.
  • Operate hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ AWS Managed Microsoft AD, federation with Entra ID (Azure AD) / AD FS, SAML / OIDC / OAuth, Kerberos, MFA.
  • Author and maintain PowerShell automation: bulk administration, scheduled tasks, configuration drift correction, reporting, and DSC where appropriate.
  • Operate the AWS hosting layer for Windows workloads: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch, Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command), Backup, Directory Service.
  • Manage IIS in depth: sites, application pools, bindings, ARR / URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, and performance tuning.
  • Drive observability of the Windows estate: event log strategy, performance baselines, CloudWatch metrics & alarms, Grafana dashboards.
  • Author runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles to codify operational standards.
  • Participate in ITIL incident, problem, and change management; act as senior on-call escalation.


Essential Skills & Experience

Windows Server & Microsoft Infrastructure (Primary)

  • 7+ years operating Windows Server in production, with deep hands-on experience on Windows Server 2019 and above.
  • Active Directory at depth: forest/domain design, replication, FSMO roles, trusts, sites & services, schema, tombstone & recovery.
  • Group Policy at scale: design, troubleshooting (RSoP, gpresult), security baselines, WMI filtering.
  • IIS at depth: site & app pool configuration, ARR, URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, performance tuning.
  • DNS, DHCP, WSUS, and Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) — real operational experience.
  • Advanced PowerShell: scripting, modules, remoting, error handling, automation patterns, DSC familiarity.
  • Windows patching at scale: planning, deployment, rollback, and troubleshooting in regulated environments.
  • Windows performance troubleshooting: PerfMon, ETW, memory dump analysis, IIS request diagnostics.

Identity & Authentication

  • Hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ cloud, Entra ID (Azure AD) Connect / federation, AD FS.
  • SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, Kerberos, LDAP, MFA — practical implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Certificate management and PKI in enterprise Windows environments.

AWS Hosting Platform (Operational Competence)

  • Day-to-day comfort operating Windows workloads in AWS: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch.
  • AWS Systems Manager for Windows fleet management: Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command, State Manager, Parameter Store.
  • AWS Directory Service / Managed Microsoft AD / AD Connector.

Note: Deep AWS architect-level expertise is not required. We hire for Windows depth; the cloud layer is the platform, and we expect strong fundamentals plus willingness to grow.

Service Operations & Remote Working

  • Strong ITIL grounding: incident, problem, change, and service lifecycle management.
  • Prior experience in an MSP or shared-services environment — multiple client estates managed under SLA.
  • Advanced / fluent professional English, written and spoken.
  • Reliable, distraction-free home office with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video setup.
  • Ability to work New York-aligned hours consistently, with the same presence and responsiveness as an office-based colleague.

Working Hours, Remote Setup & Engagement

This role is 100% remote and 100% individual contributor. To match the responsiveness of an office-based engineer:

  • Working hours: You will operate aligned to New York business hours (08:30–17:30 ET). Typical Brazil hours: 09:30–18:30 BRT during EDT (US summer) and 10:30–19:30 BRT during EST (US winter). You must be online, responsive, and actively engaged throughout core hours, the same as if you were sat with the team in the office.
  • Home office: Quiet, ergonomic workspace with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video / audio setup. This is not a digital-nomad role.
  • Engagement model: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) or via Employer of Record — confirmed during recruitment. Tax, invoicing, and benefits arrangements discussed at offer stage.
  • Equipment & expenses: Discussed at offer stage.
  • On-call: Participation in a senior escalation rota for major incidents — compensated in line with policy.

Seu principal objetivo será garantir a estabilidade do produto na ponta e blindar nossa produção contra comportamentos inesperados. Você trabalhará em linha direta com o time de Suporte para identificar dores dos clientes, desenhar soluções autônomas e implementar uma cultura rigorosa de testes automatizados.


O que você fará no dia a dia:

  • Construir e Proteger: Desenvolver novas funcionalidades e interfaces integrando nosso ecossistema moderno (Supabase + ferramentas de codificação por IA).
  • Automação de Qualidade (Sua principal missão): Criar e manter uma suíte robusta de testes funcionais End-to-End (E2E) usando Playwright ou Cypress para garantir que as lógicas de negócio e fluxos complexos (como webhooks do WhatsApp e CRM) nunca quebrem na ponta.

O Perfil que Buscamos:

  • Experiência sólida com o ecossistema moderno de JavaScript / TypeScript e bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL / Supabase).
  • Domínio real de ferramentas de testes E2E (Playwright ou Cypress) e esteiras de CI/CD (GitHub Actions).
  • Mindset de Product Engineer: Você se importa mais com a experiência do advogado usando o sistema e com a estabilidade do fluxo do que com o código isolado.
  • Conhecimento prático em consumo de APIs assíncronas e gerenciamento de Webhooks.
  • Desejo genuíno de assumir responsabilidade, gerenciar o próprio tempo (trabalho baseado em Roadmap e ciclos assíncronos) e evoluir para uma cadeira de liderança (Tech Lead).


Diferenciais que vamos amar:

  • Já utilizar o Cursor ou Claude Code no seu fluxo de trabalho diário.
  • Passagem prévia por Startups early-stage ou Software Houses de alta performance.
